shortDescription: Explore your culinary creativity with the Electrolux Gas Cooktop with a flexible brass power burner that allows you to achieve accurate and efficient temperature control from a rapid boil to a bare simmer and everything in between.
metaDescription: Explore your culinary creativity with the Electrolux gas cooktop with a flexible brass power burner that allows you to achieve accurate and efficient temperature control from a rapid boil to a bare simmer and everything in between.

features.text: Achieve accurate and efficient temperature control - whether you need a light simmer or a powerful boil - with a flexible brass power burner that evenly covers the bottom of the pan
Easily slide even your heaviest cookware from burner to burner with our continuous grates that also lend to the sleek look of the cooktop
Get a premium look with sturdy, LED backlit knobs that turn on once the burner is lit
Full-framed linear grates, edge-to-edge front controls with sturdy LED backlit knobs and a premium brass burner accent lend to the sleek design that make this cooktop a focal point of your kitchen
Create specialty foods like crepes and paninis right on your cooktop with an included griddle that allows for multiple cooking techniques
Easily melt chocolate and other delicate ingredients with the gentle heat provided by the melt cap accessory
Cook for a crowd with ease with five burners that allow you to cook multiple dishes at once
